title: Visual Acuity (Distance)
description: Test the clarity of your vision using a digital Snellen chart.

title: Near Vision Acuity
description: Test your near vision clarity, important for reading and other close-up tasks.

title: Color Vision Test
description: Screen for color blindness with an algorithmically generated Ishihara test.

title: Farnsworth D-15
description: An advanced color vision test where you arrange colored caps in order.

title: Astigmatism Test
description: Check for astigmatism using a clock dial test.

title: Contrast Sensitivity Test
description: Measure your ability to distinguish between different shades, which can be affected by conditions like cataracts.

title: Macular Health (Amsler)
description: Monitor for macular degeneration with an interactive Amsler grid.

title: Peripheral Vision Game
description: Train your peripheral awareness. This can help screen for vision loss associated with glaucoma.

title: Cover Test for Strabismus
description: A guided self-test to screen for eye misalignment (strabismus).

title: Corneal Topography Simulation
description: Use a Placido's Disk simulation to screen for corneal irregularities like keratoconus.

title: Ocular Health Scan
description: AI-powered analysis of an eye photo for cataracts, pterygium, and more.

title: Pupil Response Test
description: Neurological screening via camera-based pupil measurement. (Experimental)

title: Redness & Irritation Scan
description: AI-powered analysis of eye redness from a photo. (Experimental)

title: Stereopsis Test
description: A screening for depth perception and 3D vision (requires 3D glasses).

title: Reading Speed Test
description: Assess your visual processing and reading efficiency.

title: Accommodation Flexibility Test
description: Quantify how quickly your eyes can change focus.

title: Jungle Explorer
description: A fun game for kids! Help the jungle explorer spot all the animals by quickly changing your focus.

title: Cosmic Racer
description: A smooth pursuit tracking game. Follow the spaceship with your eyes as it races through the cosmos.

title: Word Builder
description: A fast-paced game where you unscramble letters to form words. Great for visual processing!

title: Visual Snake
description: The classic snake game, designed to improve peripheral vision and reaction time.

title: Puzzle Fusion
description: Dichoptic training for amblyopia and binocular vision.

title: Laser Maze
description: Smooth pursuit eye tracking training.

title: Brock String
description: Digital convergence and divergence training.

title: Dry Eye Detector
description: Monitor your blink rate to identify digital eye strain.
